summary: MLFQ with 2 queues and quanta of 10 and 50 executed four processes sequentially, causing long waiting times and high turnaround times. The algorithm failed to overlap execution, resulting in poor performance.
main_reason: The MLFQ implementation did not perform any preemptions, causing processes to run one after another without time slicing, which led to convoy effect where short jobs wait behind long jobs.
evidence: process timeline shows sequential execution with gaps between first_run times (0, 9, 15, 22)
suggestion: Round Robin (RR) with quantum=1 would likely perform better because it would interleave execution of processes, reducing waiting times and improving turnaround time. RR achieved avg_turnaround_time of 8.75 with 12 preemptions.
